_comment: Legacy Arabic SHX fonts (xarb.shx, xarab.shx) store text as ASCII key codes that the font draws as Arabic glyphs. On 2026-10-28 the owner chose the conversion-table approach (ADR-019): `mappings` holds the lowercase keys of the Windows Arabic 101 keyboard layout (q -> ض ... / -> ظ, b -> لا). A text in a legacy font is decoded only when EVERY character is a digit, a space or a key in `mappings`; any other character (upper-case keys and punctuation such as U, H, F, or the backtick) keeps the whole text readable=false for review. Extend the table only with forms confirmed by the owner.
status: confirmed 2026-10-28 (owner): lowercase Arabic 101 table; upper-case/punctuation keys and the backtick (ذ) are deliberately absent
evidence: Lowercase keys follow the Windows Arabic 101 keyboard layout in logical order: lrhfv = مقابر, ,vam = ورشة, lk,v = منور, fb' = بلط, fg,; 5 = بلوك 5, ahvU = شارع. Upper-case and punctuation keys select other glyph forms (e.g. U = ع, H = ا, F/D/K/M/L = final forms) and are not derivable from the data.
